name: companyHashedUrl
label: Company URL
help: Public or hashed LinkedIn company URL, including /company/... and /sales/company/... or an alert subject URL.

name: listId
label: List ID
help: ID of one of your account lists, or of My Current Accounts, to also add the account to. Find it in the Retrieve Lists output or at the end of the list's URL. Leave empty to only save the account. With more than 10 account lists, a list that Sales Navigator's menu hides cannot be used and the module fails.
